name: Shinya Mori
description: Since 2022, he has worked on researching public goods funding mechanisms though quantitative comparative analysis of various grant programs. In 2023, he co-founded Fracton Research (Beacon Labs). He has spoken at Devcon SEA and Funding the Commons Bangkok and Buenos Aires. He was a member of Grant Innovation Lab by Metagov and Polygon Community grant council. In 2024, he co-founded imi and began his artistic practice. He co-organizes kuu village for alternative lives leveraged by Ethereum.
